## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and run locally
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG (Unreleased) updated where behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, account data, or private datasets included
- [ ] ML changes include reproducible experiment details (data range, splits, seeds, cost model)
- [ ] No profitability claims without reproducible, cost-aware, out-of-sample evidence
- [ ] Risk checks and account safeguards are not weakened or bypassed
- [ ] Third-party code and its license are disclosed
